text_en: A great portent appeared in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, with the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars.
text_cn: 那时，天上出现了一个大异兆：有一个女人，身披太阳，脚踏月亮，头戴十二颗星的荣冠；

text_en: She was pregnant and was crying out in birth pangs, in the agony of giving birth.
text_cn: 她胎中怀了孕，在产痛和苦劳中，呼疼呻吟。

text_en: Then another portent appeared in heaven: a great red dragon, with seven heads and ten horns, and seven diadems on his heads.
text_cn: 随着天上又出现了另一个异兆：有一条火红的大龙，有七个头，十只角，头上戴着七个王冠。

text_en: His tail swept down a third of the stars of heaven and threw them to the earth. Then the dragon stood before the woman who was about to bear a child, so that he might devour her child as soon as it was born.
text_cn: 它的尾巴将天上的星辰勾下了三分之一，投在地上。那条龙便站在那要生产的女人面前，待她生产后，要吞下她的孩子。

text_en: And she gave birth to a son, a male child, who is to rule all the nations with a rod of iron. But her child was snatched away and taken to God and to his throne;
text_cn: 那女人生了一个男孩子，他就是那要以铁杖牧放万民的；那女人的孩子被提到天主和他的宝座前。

text_en: and the woman fled into the wilderness, where she has a place prepared by God, so that there she can be nourished for one thousand two hundred sixty days.
text_cn: 女人就逃到旷野去了，在那里有天主已给她准备好的地方，叫她在那里受供养一千二百六十天。

text_en: And war broke out in heaven; Michael and his angels fought against the dragon. The dragon and his angels fought back,
text_cn: 以后，天上就发生了战争：弥额尔和他的天使一同与那龙交战，那龙也和它的使者一起应战，

text_en: but they were defeated, and there was no longer any place for them in heaven.
text_cn: 但它们敌不住，在天上遂再也没有它们的地方了。

text_en: The great dragon was thrown down, that ancient serpent, who is called the Devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole world—he was thrown down to the earth, and his angels were thrown down with him.
text_cn: 于是那大龙被摔了下来，它就是那远古的蛇，号称魔鬼或撒殚的。那欺骗了全世界的，被摔到地上，它的使者也同它一起被摔了下来。

text_en: Then I heard a loud voice in heaven, proclaiming, “Now have come the salvation and the power and the kingdom of our God and the authority of his Messiah, for the accuser of our comrades has been thrown down, who accuses them day and night before our God.
text_cn: 那时我听见天上有大声音说：“如今我们的天主获得了胜利、权能和国度，也显示了他基督的权柄，因为那日夜在我们的天主前，控告我们弟兄的控告者，已被摔下去了。

text_en: But they have conquered him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony, for they did not cling to life even in the face of death.
text_cn: 他们赖羔羊的血和他们作证的话，得胜了那条龙，因为他们情愿牺牲自己的性命死了。

text_en: Rejoice then, you heavens and those who dwell in them! But woe to the earth and the sea, for the devil has come down to you with great wrath, because he knows that his time is short! ”
text_cn: 为此，高天和住在那里的，你们欢乐罢！祸哉，大地和海洋！因为魔鬼怀着大怒下到你们那里去了，因为他知道自己只有很短的时间了。”

text_en: So when the dragon saw that he had been thrown down to the earth, he pursued the woman who had given birth to the male child.
text_cn: 那条龙一看见自己被摔到地上，就去追赶那生了男婴的女人。

text_en: But the woman was given the two wings of the great eagle, so that she could fly from the serpent into the wilderness, to her place where she is nourished for a time, and times, and half a time.
text_cn: 可是有大鹰的两个翅膀给了那女人，为叫她飞入旷野，到自己的地方去，在那里受供养一段时期、两段时期和半段时期，远离那蛇的面。

text_en: Then from his mouth the serpent poured water like a river after the woman, to sweep her away with the flood.
text_cn: 那蛇遂在女人后面，从自己的口中吐出一道像河的水，为使那女人被河水冲去；

text_en: But the earth came to the help of the woman; it opened its mouth and swallowed the river that the dragon had poured from his mouth.
text_cn: 可是大地却援助了那女人，大地裂开一个口，把那条龙从口中所吐出的河水吸了去。

text_en: Then the dragon was angry with the woman, and went off to make war on the rest of her children, those who keep the commandments of God and hold the testimony of Jesus.
text_cn: 那条龙便对那女人大发忿怒，遂去与她其余的后裔，即那些遵行天主的诫命，且为耶稣作证的人交战；

text_en: Then the dragon took his stand on the sand of the seashore.
